title: Former captain introduces new PPD contact at Base 2
summary: Dan Sherman tells of Former captain introduces new PPD contact at Base 2, about early 1990s at Base 2, a large multi-service detachment (US), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I was working my regular job and the introduction happened by the previous captain actually showing up at my job

plain: Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says he was secretly trained to receive messages from aliens in his head, says that in the early 1990s he was working his regular job at a large shared military post he calls Base 2. He says the captain who used to oversee him, whom he calls Captain White, simply showed up at his workplace to introduce him to a new contact for the programme.
